intro: Rebirthing starts you on a new life. Your base is wiped and every item that isn't Reborn-proof or soulbound is deleted from your inventory. The option is in Settings.
In return you get at least one powerful Reborn item. The further you go, the rarer and stronger the items get: some only unlock after thousands of lives, and every item is unlocked by life 10,000.
You can also land a Slipstream item, which is very strong but vanishes when you next rebirth. Rebirths can also give Inferno Boxes, and event boxes or currency during events.
